lessons_used: Predictions were generally overoptimistic, though recent winning tests (like home wait info) were underpredicted.
Adding a new finish screen (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance or failed to help across multiple tests.
Sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy) consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) and adding home wait info (home, wait_info) produced winning tests, but evidence remains thin with only one test each.
Redesigning the home screen (home, redesign) hurt performance, but evidence is still thin from a single test.
Evidence remains thin for all other change types (hints, incentives, new flows, adoption wait info) as each has only been tested once.

candidates.title: Move sign-in after waiting screen
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to occur right after pet generation completes on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The sign-in step has a 567s mean duration, and letting users wait for generation first reduces setup friction.

sign_in.headline: Save your desktop pet to your account

guard.reason: Moving sign-in within onboarding is explicitly permitted by Rule 4 and all required steps are retained.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in previously showed positive results (+2.8%), targeting a high-duration sign-in step.

candidates.title: Pet Desktop Placement Preview Screen
candidates.change: Add a new preview screen right before finishing onboarding to demonstrate how the pet lives on the desktop taskbar.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple inquiries regarding pets not appearing on screen or confusion on desktop interaction.

new_placement_preview.headline: See how your pet appears on your desktop
new_placement_preview.body: Your pet sits quietly in your taskbar corner. You can drag them anywhere or right-click to hide.

guard.reason: Adding a new preview screen within onboarding before home_intro is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support and funnel, but adding new finish screens consistently hurts performance.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Status Checklist Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen layout to a checklist structure showing real-time pet rendering stages.
candidates.why: The home waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing drop-offs due to uncertainty.

components.text: Rendering 3D model, Setting up animations, Enabling desktop interaction

guard.reason: Redesigning the waiting screen layout to a checklist still shows the pet is being made.

candidates.score_note: Home screen redesigns previously hurt conversion (-3.0%) and require building a new layout.

candidates.title: Quick Start Preset Adoption Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a fast-track instant adoption action on the pick_friend screen to adopt standard pets without photo uploads.
candidates.why: Adoption step conversion is only 60.9% with a high mean time of 1017s, and photo generation can fail.

pick_friend.headline: Pick a companion or create a custom pet

guard.reason: Adding an instant adoption action on pick_friend maintains the required onboarding flow and step requirements.

candidates.score_note: Targets adoption step with 39.1% drop-off; new flow showed modest gain (+2.4%) in past tests.

candidates.title: Completion Sound Notification on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Play a completion chime and send a system notification when generation finishes on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Users leave the app idling in the background during long waits (mean 2336s) and do not notice when ready.

guard.reason: Adding completion chime and notifications on the waiting screen is permitted under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long wait time (2336s mean) via background notifications, but untested as a notification pattern.

candidates.title: Existing Account Pet Sync Hint
candidates.change: Add a account recovery hint on the sign-in screen explaining pet account synchronization.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails reporting missing or reset pets after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your previous account to restore your existing desktop pet profile.

components.text: Already created a pet? Sign into your original account to restore pet data.

guard.reason: Adding account recovery hint copy on the sign-in screen is compliant with all rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong support mail alignment and low cost, but sign-in copy tweaks consistently show no clear effect.

candidates.title: Story Screen Compact Layout
candidates.change: Change story screen layout to compact to move users into path choice faster.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s, indicating stalling early in onboarding.

story.headline: Welcome to your new desktop companion

guard.reason: Changing the story screen layout to compact is allowed as long as it continues to introduce the pet.

candidates.score_note: Targets 23.8% drop-off and 514s mean duration on choose_path with a minor layout adjustment.

candidates.title: Time Remaining Countdown Estimate
candidates.change: Display a dynamic time estimate countdown timer on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: High mean wait time (2336s) on the waiting screen leads users to abandon the app while generation runs.

guard.reason: Displaying a time estimate countdown during a real wait on the waiting screen is explicitly allowed under Rule 5.

candidates.score_note: Home wait info changes are proven winners (+5.0%) for mitigating drop-off during long generation times.

candidates.title: Home Intro Companion Controls Guide Badge
candidates.change: Add an interactive controls guide badge component to the home_intro screen.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% and post-onboarding support indicates confusion regarding pet controls.

home_intro.headline: Your pet is now active on your desktop!

components.text: Quick Tip: Right-click pet on desktop to open settings or talk

guard.reason: Adding an interactive guide badge to home_intro is allowed as home_intro is part of onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Supported by support feedback on high drop-off finish step, but hints/incentives on finish step underperformed.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Guidelines Helper Copy
candidates.change: Update body copy on upload_photos screen with explicit instructions on clear photo lighting and subject framing.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong.

upload_photos.body: For best pet generation, upload well-lit photos showing your pet centered and facing forward.

guard.reason: Asks the user to upload personal photos.

picked: Home Intro Companion Controls Guide Badge

decisions.title: Home Intro Companion Controls Guide Badge

lessons_next: Predictions were generally overoptimistic for large changes, though winning tests were often underpredicted.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) consistently worked and proved helpful across 2 tests.
Adding a new finish screen (finish, new_screen) hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy) and new adoption flows (adoption, new_flow) showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
Evidence remains thin for all other change types (hints, incentives, redesigns, layout changes, and home wait info) due to single tests or mixed results.
